turns.text: In my view, the education system in Pakistan focuses too heavily on memorisation rather than critical thinking.
Students often learn answers by heart just to pass exams, and then they forget most of it after a few weeks.
I believe schools should encourage more project-based learning, where students actually apply what they've studied.
That said, I don't think it's entirely the teachers' fault, since they're under pressure to complete the syllabus on time.
If I were in charge, I'd probably start by reducing class sizes, because it's almost impossible to give attention to sixty students.
